dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: #Oh, hey there, {NICKNAME}. Nice to see ya!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Didn't expect to see you here at this hour, Dehya.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Hahaha, well, Cyno's out of the country on a trip, so he got me to come and help his subordinates take care of a few things. I guess you could say I'm his temporary substitute.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: The atmosphere around here's not too bad nowadays, so I don't mind sticking around once in a while.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: You've probably got a lot going on yourself, I'll bet? Good luck with everything!
